usph_formula: Useful stories = events selected (or further) in the period, except those rejected as duplicate or incorrect; active hours = activity sessions with gaps up to 15 min.

ai_load.title: AI load

verdict.tight: The AI is at its limit: the queue may grow at peak hours
verdict.overloaded: The AI can't keep up: more events arrive than the model can handle
verdict.failing: The AI isn't responding: most recent calls failed. Check that the model server is running and the models are downloaded
verdict.off: No AI connected: posts use the template, no translations

ai_load.share: AI needs {share} of the day with current settings
ai_load.share_label: Share of the day the AI needs
ai_load.flow: Flow: {important} important events a day (high — {high}, medium — {medium}) from {sources} sources.
ai_load.backlog: Queued now: {posts} posts, {translations} translations. Clears in ≈ {eta}.
ai_load.headroom: Headroom: ≈ {events} more important events a day — about {sources} more sources of the same volume.
ai_load.advice_title: What to change so the AI keeps up

advice.posts_high: Let the AI write posts only for high-importance events; medium ones get the template, AI on Rewrite.
advice.translate_high: Translate only high-importance events in the background; others get translated when opened.
advice.briefs_off: Turn off automatic AI briefs — keep them on request.
advice.posts_by_button: First version of the post from the template; AI only on Rewrite.
advice.smaller_model: Model {model} takes ≈ {post_s} s per post. A smaller model (e.g. qwen3:8b) is about twice as fast — change it in the ai_routing settings.
advice.noisy_source: Source “{name}” produced {events} important events and none was taken. Turn it off or lower its tier.

ai_load.share_after: load after this ≈ {share} of the day
ai_load.need_settings: Only an administrator can change settings
